title: 2 Dozen Brands, One Background Tab: How Prop Firm Match’s Affiliate Redirect Slipped Past Its Partners
summary: About 21 brands, including Apex Trader Funding, Tradeify, Lucid Trading, Goat Funded Trader, FundingPips and Blue Guardian, have ended their partnerships with Prop Firm Match since the first exits were announced on Friday, 30 October. The comparison platform, which has 38 prop firm partners as of pr...
content:
2026-11-02T14:32:47.210+02:00

Monday, 02/11/2026 | 12:32 GMT by Arnab Shome

  • About 21 brands have ended Prop Firm Match partnerships since Friday, after the platform said clicks on firm pages and codes opened partner sites through affiliate links.
  • A source says misattributed sales looked like normal referrals and cookie windows varied by firm. FundingPips’ CEO says his firm caught the practice in August.

About 21 brands, including Apex Trader Funding, Tradeify, Lucid Trading, Goat Funded Trader, FundingPips and Blue Guardian, have ended their partnerships with Prop Firm Match since the first exits were announced on Friday, 30 October. The comparison platform, which has 38 prop firm partners as of press time after shedding almost two dozen brands, acknowledged that clicks on firm profiles and promo codes on its site opened partner websites through its affiliate links. The scale of the exits raises a question across the prop trading industry: how did the firms paying the commissions not spot it sooner?

London's trading industry is coming home!

A statement from the platform on X said: “This should not have happened. We take full responsibility for it.” The company said it has contacted each partner to review the matter and reconcile any inaccuracies. Prop Firm Match is expected to release another update later today (Monday).

Three years ago, Prop Firm Match launched. Two traders saw a gap in the market for a platform providing simplicity and transparency for prop firm traders. We developed new features not seen before: verified reviews, payout tracking across all payment methods, live spreads, rule overviews, simple ways to compare prop firms, and prop firm expos. Three years in, PFM has had over 25M website visits, reached over 370,000 members, and has given out free challenge accounts worth over $1,400,000 to the PFM community. Over 100 firms apply to be listed each year and go through one of the industry’s most rigorous compliance processes. We also got something wrong. Until yesterday, when someone clicked on a firm or a code on our site, a new tab would open the firm’s site through our affiliate link. This should not have happened. We take full responsibility for it. We have reached out to each of our partners to review this together and reconcile any inaccuracies. We respect any decisions firms have made based on this. We truly appreciate the partners and traders who value the relationship we have built together over the years. We promise you that we will learn from this, hold ourselves to the highest standard, and come back stronger and better.

— Prop Firm Match (@PropFirmMatch) October 31, 2026

A source close to the matter said the misattributed sales would have been difficult for partner firms to spot because they might have looked identical to legitimate affiliate referrals. Attribution relied on tracking cookies whose lifespan each firm set for itself, ranging from a few hours to several months.

According to the source, the cookies were triggered before users had committed to a purchase. A trader drawn in by a firm’s own advertising could later buy directly from that firm, and the commission would still be credited to Prop Firm Match. With the major firms spending heavily on marketing, the source said, such cases were common and blended into normal affiliate traffic.

Read more: Prop Firms Drop Prop Firm Match over Affiliate Link Allegations

The commercial terms between the platform and its partners are not uniform. Some firms were affiliates, paying commission on challenges sold through Prop Firm Match links and codes, an arrangement the platform’s website discloses. Topstep founder and CEO Michael Patak, meanwhile, said his firm had no affiliate code and instead paid $10,000 a month for a listing, with a best rank of sixth. The platform’s published policy says no firm can buy a ranking.

fyi - we are dropping Prop firm Match.. we didn't have a code and we paid them $10k a month to list us (best rank we got was 6th place.. i heard 1st cost $100k/m) ... now we save $10k a month... time to have a @TopstepTV Fire Drill (thats where we give away stuff on tv) .. we got an extra $10,000 a month in our budget!! Let go!

— mp (@MichaelPatak) October 30, 2026

Three days after the scandal surfaced, big brands, including FTMO, T5ers, FundedNext and E8 Markets are still listed on the prop firm comparison website.

A Redirect That Looked Like Routine Traffic

A video posted on Thursday, 29 October by Trader Kane, who runs rival comparison site Prop Firm Compare, showed the behaviour. Clicking a firm profile or copy code button on Prop Firm Match opened the requested page in a new tab while the original tab went through an affiliate link. Kane said this happens on “most firms listed on their website” and that he had not checked them all.

Are we still on the "deceitful marketing algo"? Hey @PropFirmMatch, did you knowingly push an update that stuffs cookies when people aren’t clicking links advertised in the code as external websites? Here’s what happens: someone clicks the profile page or copy code link that links to the internal page and your javascript handler redirects the original tab through an affiliate link to the firm’s website and opens the intended link a new tab... sounds pretty knowing to me. You even ban your affiliates from forcing cookies.. but you can, huh? Some pretty big affiliates have gone to prison for cookie stuffing. I used @MattLeech's MFFU as an example in this video but this happens on most firms listed on their website (I didn't check them all). Firms are banning traders for deceitful marketing, if this isn't deceitful what is?

— kane🧪 (@traderkane) October 29, 2026

An Internet Archive review of the platform’s JavaScript by Alex Firdaus found the copy code function sending the original tab to affiliate URLs in every capture from 30 November 2025 to 24 October 2026. Firdaus is head of media at FinMedia Group and editor-in-chief of FundedTrading.com, which competes with Prop Firm Match.

According to the analysis, the code fired once per firm per day, tracked in the browser’s local storage, which would explain why repeat tests appeared normal. The archive does not show how many traders the redirect reached or whether any firm paid commission because of it, the analysis states. Finance Magnates has not independently verified it.

The allegation differs from classic cookie stuffing in how the tracking link fires. In cookie stuffing, as Firdaus describes it, an affiliate cookie is set without any click, usually on page load. Here, users clicked a firm profile or copy code button, and the affiliate link loaded in the original tab while the requested page opened in a new one. Firdaus calls this a forced click. Whether it breaches a firm’s terms depends on how its affiliate agreement defines a click, he said.

Partner Responses and the Precedents on the Books

Exits came with short statements. Apex Trader Funding said it had “terminated its affiliate relationship with Prop Firm Match, effective immediately” after a review of referral tracking practices, without saying what the review found. Tradeify said referrals to its site “broke our affiliate terms” and that Prop Firm Match will no longer sponsor the Premier Trading League. Goat Funded Trader also cited a review. “We do not compromise on transparency, accurate attribution, or responsible marketing,” it said.

On X, Khaled of FundingPips wrote: “We have caught the cookies practices in August.” He said the firm took action, and that its ranking on the platform then fell from number one best seller to number ten. He added that the firm is forfeiting the month’s commissions and will pursue financial claims.

Effective immediately @PropFirmMatch affiliate partnership is terminated. All their commissions for the month are forfeited, and financial claims are going to be pursued. We have caught the cookies practices in August, took actions on it and Our rank dropped from Nr. 1 best seller to Nr.10. Plus being told that traders picking us over other firms costs them money, which I understand since their commission is same as any other affiliate. Since the beginning we have supported them, tech, expertise and features, yet that business grew into something I personally don’t believe in. Adios 👊🏽

— Khaled (@Khldfx) October 30, 2026

In November 2025, Finance Magnates reported that Prop Firm Match delisted PipFarm after an extensive review, having earlier suspended or delisted firms including True Forex Funds and The Funded Trader. CEO Martin Jensen said at the time: “I’d rather be criticized for requesting too much than too little.” The platform then said its site drew more than 1.2 million monthly visits. In its latest statement, it cited more than 25 million visits and 370,000 members in three years.

Here, users clicked a firm profile or copy code button, and the affiliate link loaded in the original tab while the requested page opened in a new one. Firdaus calls this a forced click. Whether it breaches a firm’s terms depends on how its affiliate agreement defines a click, he said.

Partner Responses and the Precedents on the Books

Exits came with short statements. Apex Trader Funding said it had “terminated its affiliate relationship with Prop Firm Match, effective immediately” after a review of referral tracking practices, without saying what the review found. Tradeify said referrals to its site “broke our affiliate terms” and that Prop Firm Match will no longer sponsor the Premier Trading League. Goat Funded Trader also cited a review. “We do not compromise on transparency, accurate attribution, or responsible marketing,” it said.

On X, Khaled of FundingPips wrote: “We have caught the cookies practices in August.” He said the firm took action, and that its ranking on the platform then fell from number one best seller to number ten. He added that the firm is forfeiting the month’s commissions and will pursue financial claims.

Effective immediately @PropFirmMatch affiliate partnership is terminated. All their commissions for the month are forfeited, and financial claims are going to be pursued. We have caught the cookies practices in August, took actions on it and Our rank dropped from Nr. 1 best seller to Nr.10. Plus being told that traders picking us over other firms costs them money, which I understand since their commission is same as any other affiliate. Since the beginning we have supported them, tech, expertise and features, yet that business grew into something I personally don’t believe in. Adios 👊🏽

— Khaled (@Khldfx) October 30, 2026

In November 2025, Finance Magnates reported that Prop Firm Match delisted PipFarm after an extensive review, having earlier suspended or delisted firms including True Forex Funds and The Funded Trader. CEO Martin Jensen said at the time: “I’d rather be criticized for requesting too much than too little.” The platform then said its site drew more than 1.2 million monthly visits. In its latest statement, it cited more than 25 million visits and 370,000 members in three years.

title: Ethereum (ETH) Price Prediction: Whale Longs Surge as $2,200 Demand Zone Puts $3,000 Back in Focus
summary: Ethereum (ETH) price prediction remains at a critical juncture as whale longs surge, ETF outflows persist, and bulls defend the $2,200 demand zone for a potential recovery toward $3,000.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: ETH

Ethereum (ETH) price prediction remains at a critical juncture as whale longs surge, ETF outflows persist, and bulls defend the $2,200 demand zone for a potential recovery toward $3,000.

Ethereum is attempting to stabilize after another difficult stretch, with price returning to an area that has repeatedly played an important role in previous market cycles. The broader picture is beginning to split between price weakness and improving fundamentals. According to Brave New Coin, ETH price is trading around $2,291.31, up 1.08% over the past 24 hours.

Ethereum Returns to a Demand Zone Near $2,200

Ethereum is back inside one of the more important areas on its weekly chart. Blockto’s analysis places ETH inside a broad demand zone around $2,100-$2,400, an area that has acted as support during several previous market swings.

ETH price is now trading near $2,290 after testing the lower half of that zone. If buyers continue to defend the area, the first recovery would bring $2,600-$2,700 back into focus, followed by the broader $3,000-$3,200 region where Ethereum previously faced heavier resistance.

The downside scenario becomes more relevant if ETH starts losing the demand zone altogether. In that case, the weekly chart leaves room for a deeper move toward roughly $1,500-$1,600 before another major support area comes into play.

Further out, the chart continues to show the $4,100-$4,700 region as the major higher-timeframe resistance. Ethereum would need to rebuild through several levels before that zone becomes relevant again, but holding the current demand area would be the first step toward restoring that larger structure.

Source: Blockto via X

Whale Longs Build While ETF Pressure Remains High

Ethereum’s positioning data is starting to show a clear split between large traders and institutional fund flows. Merlin The Trader highlights a roughly 368% increase in whale long exposure, with whales now carrying around 3.6 times more long positions than they did in August.

Ethereum whale longs have surged 368% since August, signaling growing bullish positioning. Source: Merlin The Trader via X

That buildup suggests larger market participants are using the recent weakness to increase bullish exposure. Ethereum price is still trading close to its support region, so the increase in whale longs becomes more meaningful if price begins to stabilize and recover from current levels.

Ethereum spot ETFs recorded $155.7 million in outflows on October 30, led by BlackRock’s ETHA. Source: DustyBC via X

The ETF side remains less supportive. U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded approximately $155.7 million in net outflows on October 30, with BlackRock’s ETHA accounting for roughly $76.6 million of that total. Continued withdrawals show that institutional demand through ETF products has not yet matched the bullish positioning seen elsewhere in the market.

Ethereum Staking Adds Support to the Bullish Supply

The split between stronger whale positioning and weaker ETF flows is not the only development shaping Ethereum’s outlook. On the supply side, staking activity has continued to rise, with Cointelegraph reporting that more ETH moved into staking during October than in any previous month. Total staked ETH now stands near 44.2 million.

That trend matters because it reduces the amount of ETH that remains immediately available in the market at the same time whales are increasing long exposure. Even with ETF outflows still acting as a drag, a larger share of supply being locked away can help tighten the market if demand starts to recover.

The combination does not remove the need for price confirmation, but it strengthens the backdrop around the current support zone. If ETF pressure begins to ease while whale longs remain elevated, record staking activity could become another factor supporting a stronger recovery.

Ethereum staking climbed to roughly 44.2 million ETH. Source: Cointelegraph via X.

Ethereum Price Pattern Targeting $3,000

The improving fundamentals around Ethereum are beginning to show up on the chart as well. With whale longs rising and more ETH moving into staking, Max Crypto highlights a potential inverse head-and-shoulders pattern developing near the same demand region ETH price is currently trying to defend.

The right shoulder is still forming, which keeps the pattern unconfirmed for now. A recovery through the neckline around the mid-$2,500s would be the more important development, as that would show buyers are finally turning the recent accumulation and tighter supply conditions into actual price strength.

If that breakout develops, $3,000 becomes the next major level in the recovery path. Until then, the structure remains a developing reversal setup, with the recent lows needing to hold for the bullish pattern to stay intact.

Ethereum is forming a potential inverse head-and-shoulders, with a neckline breakout pointing towards $3,000. Source: Max Crypto via X.

ETH Price Technical Analysis

Ethereum is trying to recover after spending most of October under pressure. The one-month chart shows ETH falling from above $2,650 toward the $2,200 area before buyers finally produced a stronger reaction, with price now back near $2,287.

The latest rebound has improved the very short-term picture, but Ethereum price is still trading below several areas lost during the decline. The first challenge sits around $2,300-$2,350, while a stronger recovery would need to push back through roughly $2,400 before the October downtrend begins to look materially different.

Ethereum price is trading at around $2,287, up 0.92% in the last 24 hours. Source: Brave New Coin

The reaction around the recent low is encouraging, particularly after the increase in trading activity that accompanied the selloff. If ETH price continues building above $2,200 rather than immediately giving back the rebound, the current move could develop into a broader recovery attempt.

Final Thoughts: What’s Next in Q4 2026?

Ethereum enters the remaining part of Q4 with price still recovering from a difficult October, but the setup underneath the market has become more interesting. Whale longs are building, staking continues to remove ETH from the liquid supply, and the chart is beginning to show early reversal possibilities around a historically important demand region. ETF outflows remain the main piece still working against that improvement.

For the broader Ethereum Price Prediction, Q4 becomes more constructive if ETH price can turn the current rebound into acceptance above $2,300-$2,400 and eventually work back toward the mid-$2,000s. That would keep $3,000 relevant later in the quarter, while another loss of the $2,200 region would suggest Ethereum still has more work to do before a durable recovery develops.

title: Silver Price Forecast After the October Fed Decision as December Rate Risks Grow
summary: Prices for silver dipped below $50 per ounce on October 31, continuing a steep decline through the month.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: XAG

Prices for silver dipped below $50 per ounce on October 31, continuing a steep decline through the month.

Spot silver was $49.1465 and had dropped 5.79% on the day, according to Investing.com. Over the week, the metal depreciated by 8.89%, while it fell by 18.70% from the beginning of October.

The selling came after the Federal Reserve on Oct. 28 raised interest rates in its policy meeting and reignited inflation fears. With the prospect of silver’s recovery being determined by the interplay between monetary policy, political uncertainty and industrial demand before December, investors are now considering all three factors.

October Fed Decision Leaves December Rate Risks Unresolved

On October 28, the Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate policy unchanged at 3.75%–4.00%. The vote was 10-2 to decide, with two policymakers deciding to raise a quarter point. The Fed pointed to “resilient economic activity,” solid productivity and “elevated inflation.

Federal Reserve publishes statement of the FOMC meeting

The ruling did not put an end to hopes for additional narrowing. If inflation continues and economic growth remains robust, then rates may remain high and offer a higher opportunity cost of having no income generated from silver. Rising borrowing costs can also strain industrial demand by reducing economic activity.

The next meeting of the FOMC is December 8-9. Investors will be watching the inflation reading, employment data and the outlook of the policymakers for clues as to the next move. A rate rise would likely put pressure on silver, whereas a rate hold will help its recovery if inflation also slows.

Technical Indicators Show Deepening Selling Pressure

Silver has fallen from just above $53 to around $49.15 on the chart that was provided by Investing.com. The metal dabbled around the $48.90 mark before settling again at the end of the session. During the previous month, it lost 18.70%, and during the past six months, it lost 33.40%.

The silver price was $49.135 on TradingView on October 31, falling 5.81%. The price is trading below its 20-day moving averages, $59.736 and $62.578, respectively. Both were trending down, and that was a continuation of the bearish trend. Source: TradingView

RSI dropped to 23.70, which was below its signal average of 34.34. Readings below 30 typically represent oversold conditions. But oversold readings are not always accompanied by an immediate turnaround, especially during prolonged periods of selling.

The next downside reference is the $48.86 intraday low. Silver may be further trying to break below the level, suggesting a continued decline in the price of the precious metal. A recovery above $50 would signal initial stabilisation, and a recovery of $59.74 would show more that things are going well.

Midterm Elections Add Uncertainty to December’s Silver Outlook

Another market catalyst is coming up on Tuesday, November 3, with the US midterm elections. Congressional changes may impact fiscal talks and trade negotiations as well as investor expectations. But election results are not the sole factor affecting silver prices; their impact is tied to how they affect the dollar, Treasury yields and economic expectations.

Silver has upside potential in November as markets should price in further monetary policy tightening and inflation may hold. Silver is used in the manufacturing sector, so if consumers don’t have the money to invest, continued weakness in industrial demand could pressure prices.

There are two general cases for December.

Should inflation slow and the Fed hint at an end to the rate-hike cycle, silver may find support around the $55 level and continue to rally to the $60 level. If expectations of rates increase and inflation continues to persist, prices may reach the low end of the $48 range or drop further.

These levels are not guaranteed, but depend on the scenarios. Before identifying a rebound, investors need to watch the dollar, real yields, industrial demand and the December Fed decision.

content:
2026-11-02T14:02:33.058+02:00

Monday, 02/11/2026 | 12:02 GMT by Tareq Sikder

  • Josh Fieldhouse spent nearly three years at INFINOX in retention and conversion roles.
  • Recently, the firm appointed Jaser Mahmoud as CTO and Petros Kalaitzis as GM of its prop trading division.

Josh Fieldhouse has joined IC as Global Head of Sales & Partnerships, according to a LinkedIn post shared by him today (Monday).

London's trading industry is coming home!

IC has also made other senior appointments. The company appointed blockchain technology expert Jaser Mahmoud as Chief Technology Officer, adding an experienced digital asset infrastructure specialist to its leadership team.

Mahmoud will oversee the company's technology strategy and the development of its core systems. IC also appointed Petros Kalaitzis as General Manager of its prop trading division.

Fieldhouse's Career Spans Sales and Partnerships

Before joining IC, Fieldhouse worked at M4Markets as Global Head of Partnerships for just over a year, from September 2024 to October 2025. He previously spent around a year and five months at Trade Nation in Global Partnership Sales.

Fieldhouse spent nearly three years at INFINOX Global. He initially served as UK Head of Retention and Conversion for just over a year before moving to the role of Global Head of Conversion, which he held for around a year and a half.

Earlier in his career, Fieldhouse worked at ETX Capital as a Financial Sales Executive for more than two years.

IC Adds Haas F1 Team and Tennis Partnerships

IC has expanded its sports sponsorships through deals with MoneyGram Haas F1 Team and Australian tennis player Alexei Popyrin. The multi-year Haas agreement made IC the team's official forex trading partner, with its branding appearing on several parts of the car.

The sponsorship coincided with the company's rebranding from IC Markets to IC. Separately, Popyrin joined as a sponsored athlete ahead of the 2026 tennis season.

title: Binance Restores 15 Networks After $6.3B Hack While Outflows Surge to $5.8B
summary:
Key Takeaways: Binance was able to resume withdrawals for 15 blockchain networks. More than $5.8 billion in net withdrawals were seen over the 24 hours, as tracked by DefiLlama. The
The post Binance Restores 15 Networks After $6.3B Hack While Outflows Surge to $5.8B appeared first on CryptoNinjas.
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Binance was able to resume withdrawals for 15 blockchain networks.
  • More than $5.8 billion in net withdrawals were seen over the 24 hours, as tracked by DefiLlama.
  • The exchange is recovering from the record $6.3 billion crypto theft.

Binance is gradually resuming crypto withdrawals following one of the largest security breaches in the crypto industry’s history, the latest among which are Zcash, TON, and Sui. Meanwhile, billions of dollars are flowing out of the exchange and Binance’s liquidity and user confidence are subject to close scrutiny.

Read More: Binance $6.3B Hack Triggers FBI Probe While $3B in Stolen Crypto Gets Frozen

  • Binance Reopens Withdrawals Across 15 Crypto Networks
  • Stablecoins Return Across Major Chains
    • Binance Sees Billions Leave After $6.3B Hack
    • Withdrawal Recovery Becomes a Test of Binance Liquidity

Binance Reopens Withdrawals Across 15 Crypto Networks

Binance’s latest update added withdrawals for ZEC on Zcash, USDT and GRAM on TON, and SUI on Sui. Those are the networks that are linked to Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, XRP Ledger, Base, Dogecoin, Optimism, Arbitrum, Tron, Solana, Polygon and Avalanche C-Chain.

Latest Withdrawal Update

Withdrawals have now been re-enabled for the following networks and assets:

New:
✅ ZEC: ZEC
✅ TON: USDT, GRAM
✅ SUI: SUI

Already Enabled:
✅ BTC: BTC
✅ ETH: ETH, USDT, USDC
✅ BSC: BNB, USDT, USDC
✅ XRP: XRP
✅ Base: ETH, USDC
✅ DOGE: DOGE
✅ OP (Optimism): ETH, USDT, USDC
✅ ARBITRUM: ARB, ETH, USDT, USDC
✅ TRX: TRX, USDT
✅ SOL: SOL, USDT, USDC
✅ MATIC (Polygon): POL, USDT, USDC
✅ AVAXC: AVAX, USDT, USDC

We will continue to restore additional assets and networks in phases as security checks are completed. Further updates will be shared through official Binance channels.

— Binance (@binance) November 1, 2026

According to the exchange, it is attempting to restore the networks on a phased basis and every network is going through security and stability tests before withdrawals are turned on.

Read More: Binance $5.5B Hack Exposed: 50 EIP-7702 Nonces Opened One Hot Wallet in Minutes

Stablecoins Return Across Major Chains

Withdrawals of USDT and USDC are already enabled on several of Binance’s biggest supported networks, such as Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.

This is particularly significant since they are a significant proportion of exchange liquidity and are frequently utilized by traders swapping assets between exchange spots. Binance has announced that more assets and networks will be returning once more checks are made.

Binance Sees Billions Leave After $6.3B Hack

Heavy withdrawal activity that orchestrated the reopening. DEFLI has recorded $5.8 billion in net outflows, while Binance has recorded roughly $3.64 billion in net outflows. Binance has an estimated $171 billion worth of customer assets, and the official net outflow was around 2.1% of the total customer assets, according to Reuters.

Withdrawals came after a massive security breach where approximately $6.3 billion in crypto assets were stolen.

The FBI blamed TraderTraitor hackers, linked to a North Korean insurgency, for the attack, said Reuters. Binance, in turn, has responded that it covered approximately $6 billion of the lost assets with its Secure Asset Fund for Users and futures insurance fund.

Withdrawal Recovery Becomes a Test of Binance Liquidity

One of the most definitive signs of user responses to the hack is the rate of withdrawals. People have requested withdrawals in large numbers after Binance resumed operations, but the withdrawals seem to have settled down in recent times, Binance stated. Meanwhile, gross withdrawals did not affect overall exchange reserves, as deposits kept coming in.

In the wake of the exchange, new hot wallet addresses have also had to be created as a security response and uploaded into the exchanges Proof of Reserves infrastructure.

The big one for traders will be what happens to the flow of funds as the rest of the networks are all back. In the meantime, Binance’s gradual reopening is a serious exercise in how effective its reserves, security measures, and customer faith will be if a massive attack is implemented.

title: Lumia – Why AI Agents Could Become the Biggest Owners of Real-World Assets
summary: Michael Huynh is Chief Marketing Officer at Lumia, a blockchain built specifically for tokenized real-world assets. It aims to handle an asset’s whole lifecycle, from compliant issuance to on-chain liquidity. Michael has worked full-time in crypto marketing since 2017, with Polygon, Avalanche and a ...
content:
Skip to content

Michael Huynh is Chief Marketing Officer at Lumia, a blockchain built specifically for tokenized real-world assets. It aims to handle an asset’s whole lifecycle, from compliant issuance to on-chain liquidity. Michael has worked full-time in crypto marketing since 2017, with Polygon, Avalanche and a few hundred other projects. He also co-founded the DCENTRAL conference series, which ran events across the US and into Asia.

The link will open a new window. Click the menu and down arrow to download the file.

Why you should listen

Most of the RWA conversation so far has been about putting Treasuries on-chain and trading price exposure to gold. Michael argues that this barely scratches the surface; by his estimate, only about five percent of the opportunity has been unlocked. His real estate example shows what he means. Tokenizing a house is the easy part. The hard part is everything underneath it: deed settlement, county records, property taxes. Once those are bundled into the asset, mortgages and home equity lines of credit can follow it on-chain. The same reasoning turns tokenized gold from a trading instrument into a way for a mine to finance its next production run. That breadth is how Lumia positions itself against specialists like Ondo. Michael concedes they will win their chosen verticals, while Lumia tries to cover all the asset classes nobody has taken on yet.

The bigger bet is on the United States, and Michael is candid about what that costs. Lumia says it is deliberately building its US rails before the law arrives. He compares it to a racehorse that stays at the gate rather than wandering off to other tracks. The company has assembled a bipartisan bench of former Congressmen, including Tim Ryan and David McIntosh, with Gibson Dunn as counsel. The timing is pointed: the CLARITY Act failed a 49–50 cloture vote in the Senate in September. Michael says the stall was expected and that the US is still the market that matters, noting that institutions like BlackRock do not commit to a market without a path forward. He also explains LGP-01, which Lumia’s community passed with 95 percent support in early October. It retires the HyperNode program through a USDT buyback of future rewards and redirects the recovered tokens into a foundation fund for growth. He presents it as removing a structure that did not fit what institutional and government partners need.

The most provocative part of the conversation is about AI agents. Michael predicts, echoing Animoca Brands’ Yat Siu, that agents will become the largest holders of tokenized assets. He describes agents that score an asset against its listed price before buying, which speeds up price discovery. They would also source deals and send owners a daily summary, all within whatever permissions and spending limits the owner sets. A self-driving taxi that earns income around the clock is his example of an RWA category that does not exist on-chain yet. In the hot take round, Michael keeps at least half his heart with Bitcoin. He says agents combined with RWAs could take blockchain daily active users from one million to fifty million. He also sketches a ten-year future of reputation-based agent networks and “agentic billionaires”, and names The 100 as his favorite science fiction show.

title: Binance Hacker Moves $96M in Stolen Solana to Bitcoin as Laundering Efforts Continue
summary: The attacker behind the $6.3 billion Binance security breach has begun converting nearly $96 million worth of stolen Solana (SOL) into Bitcoin (BTC), according to on-chain tracking platform Lookonchain.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: BTC SOL

The attacker behind the $6.3 billion Binance security breach has begun converting nearly $96 million worth of stolen Solana (SOL) into Bitcoin (BTC), according to on-chain tracking platform Lookonchain.

On November 1, the wallet associated with the incident transferred approximately 486,970 SOL, valued at $46.4 million, toward Bitcoin through cross-chain service Relay Protocol.

The latest movement involves a reported stash of 970,522 SOL, worth approximately $95.9 million. The conversion marks another stage in the attacker’s efforts to move stolen cryptocurrency across blockchain networks, complicating efforts by exchanges and security firms to monitor and restrict the funds.

Binance Hacker Routes Stolen Solana Through Relay Protocol

Lookonchain identified the activity through an address labeled as belonging to the Binance attacker on Arkham Intelligence. Its November 1 post stated: “The Binance hacker is swapping the stolen 970,522 SOL ($95.9M) for BTC.”

Lookonchain reported that the hacker behind the $6.3 billion Binance-related breach is converting 970,522 stolen SOL, worth approximately $96 million, into Bitcoin. Source: @lookonchain via X

The 486,970 SOL transfer represents approximately half of the reported holdings. The remaining balance was valued at roughly $49.5 million at the time of the reported transactions. The figures describe the reported conversion pool and its initial movement, rather than a confirmed $95.9 million Bitcoin transfer completed in a single transaction.

Relay Protocol facilitates cross-chain cryptocurrency swaps by connecting users with different blockchain networks and liquidity sources. Its involvement provides another route for transferring assets between Solana and Bitcoin. However, the use of a cross-chain service does not automatically remove the transaction history or make the funds untraceable.

The latest conversion also follows earlier movements involving other stolen cryptocurrencies. Law enforcement officials have been monitoring the attacker’s wallet activity as investigators and blockchain intelligence companies work to identify transactions linked to the breach.

FBI Confirms North Korean Involvement in Binance Hack

The latest transactions come after the FBI formally attributed the October 29 Binance attack to North Korea’s state-sponsored cyber operation known as TraderTraitor. The agency announced its findings on October 31, confirming that North Korea was responsible for stealing more than $6 billion in cryptocurrency from the exchange.

The FBI attributed the record $6.3 billion cryptocurrency theft from Binance on October 29, 2026, to North Korea’s TraderTraitor hacking group, identifying it as the largest known crypto heist. Source: FBI Cyber Branch via X

Blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs had previously identified TraderTraitor as the group behind the incident. Its investigation estimated that approximately $6.36 billion in digital assets was transferred from Binance wallets across ten blockchain networks, with most of the withdrawals occurring within roughly 20 minutes.

The FBI also identified the hackers’ efforts to convert stolen assets, primarily into Ethereum. It warned that the attackers could move the funds through decentralized finance platforms and instant cryptocurrency swap services to facilitate additional laundering.

In its statement, the agency warned of “further laundering” through related technologies and urged cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain operators, analytics companies, and other service providers to block transactions associated with the identified addresses.

The latest SOL-to-BTC activity adds another layer to those concerns. Although the FBI previously highlighted Ethereum conversions, the movement reported by Lookonchain shows that the attacker is also using cross-chain infrastructure to move assets into Bitcoin.

Binance Covers 95% of Stolen Assets as Withdrawals Resume

Binance has continued replenishing the assets affected by the security breach while coordinating with law enforcement and industry partners to trace the stolen funds.

On November 1, the exchange confirmed that it had covered approximately 95% of the affected amount, up from 90% in its October 31 recovery update. The remaining 5% consists of less-liquid tokens that may require additional time to acquire through market purchases and over-the-counter transactions.

Binance has expanded withdrawal services to include DOGE on its native network and ETH, USDT, and USDC on Optimism, following earlier resumptions across BTC, ETH, BSC, XRP, and Base. Source: Binance via X

The replenishment effort has involved the Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU), a portion of the Futures Insurance Fund, and Binance’s corporate treasury. The exchange has repeatedly stated that customers will not bear the financial impact of the attack.

“Binance will absorb the financial impact of the stolen funds, not our users,” the company said in its security incident updates.

The exchange also began restoring withdrawal services in phases on November 1 after temporarily suspending withdrawals while conducting security reviews. The initial phase covered several networks and assets, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB, Solana, XRP, and Dogecoin. Binance said it would gradually restore additional services as security checks were completed.

The company separately reported that approximately $3 billion in affected assets had been frozen on-chain through coordination with law enforcement, blockchain intelligence firms, asset issuers and other industry participants. This represents a separate enforcement and recovery effort from Binance’s own asset-replenishment commitment.

Bitcoin Conversion Complicates Crypto Recovery Efforts

Moving stolen cryptocurrency into Bitcoin can create additional challenges for investigators, particularly when transactions pass through multiple networks and wallet addresses.

Unlike centralized stablecoins, which issuers can freeze at the token-contract level, Bitcoin does not have a central authority capable of freezing funds across its network. However, this does not mean that Bitcoin transactions are anonymous or impossible to trace. Its public blockchain records transactions, allowing investigators and analytics firms to follow fund movements between addresses.

Cross-chain services can complicate that process by splitting transactions across different networks and liquidity providers. Investigators may need to connect activity across multiple blockchain records to establish where assets move after each conversion. Exchanges and other regulated service providers can also restrict deposits and withdrawals associated with identified addresses.

The FBI’s request for cryptocurrency businesses and infrastructure providers to block transactions linked to TraderTraitor reflects the importance of coordinated action in containing the movement of stolen assets. Binance has also credited industry partners for helping freeze funds and track transactions following the October 29 breach.

For now, the reported movement of nearly $46.4 million in Solana toward Bitcoin remains an important development in the ongoing investigation. Whether the attacker can move the entire $95.9 million pool into BTC remains to be established. Meanwhile, the combination of public blockchain monitoring, transaction screening, and cooperation among industry participants will remain central to efforts to trace the stolen funds and prevent further transfers.

title: Quant (QNT) Price Prediction: Bulls Target $302.67 Retest After Reclaiming $200 Support
summary: Quant (QNT) has regained the psychologically important $200 level, strengthening its technical position after a volatile October.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: QNT

Quant (QNT) has regained the psychologically important $200 level, strengthening its technical position after a volatile October.

The recovery comes as Quant price breaks above a falling wedge resistance on the 8-hour chart, putting several higher price targets back in focus.

The latest technical analysis identifies $238.28, $253.48, $275.11, and $302.67 as potential upside levels if the breakout receives confirmation. However, QNT still faces resistance from the Ichimoku cloud, while mixed momentum indicators suggest that further consolidation remains possible before a sustained upward move.

QNT Reclaims $200 as Falling Wedge Breakout Draws Attention

QNT was trading around $200–$201 on November 1, recovering from recent fluctuations that pushed the token toward the $192 area. Its 24-hour trading range extended approximately from $192 to $208, reflecting continued activity around the reclaimed psychological level.

QNT has broken above the falling wedge resistance on the 8-hour chart with strong volume. Source: DigitalChartist on TradingView

The recovery follows a volatile October, during which QNT traded within a broader range of approximately $175–$223. Market capitalization estimates ranged from $2.3 billion to $2.9 billion, while daily trading volume stood between roughly $57 million and $64 million across different market snapshots.

A technical chart shared by DigitalChartist on TradingView shows QNT breaking above the descending resistance of a falling wedge on the 8-hour timeframe. The breakout was accompanied by stronger trading volume, suggesting increased buying participation during the recovery.

However, the price is now approaching the Ichimoku cloud, an indicator commonly used to assess trend direction, support, and resistance. The cloud could present an additional obstacle before QNT establishes a stronger upward trend.

DigitalChartist’s analysis also identifies a possible retest of the broken wedge resistance. Such a move would allow the market to test whether the former resistance area can become support. A successful retest followed by a decisive move above the Ichimoku cloud would provide stronger technical confirmation.

The analyst’s projected upside levels are $238.28, $253.48, $275.11, and $302.67. These are conditional chart targets rather than confirmed price levels, with each depending on the continuation of the breakout structure.

QNT Price Prediction: Moving Averages Support the Broader Uptrend

QNT’s daily chart presents a constructive longer-term picture, although short-term momentum remains less decisive. The token is trading above most of its tracked moving averages, indicating that the broader recovery structure remains intact.

The 10-day simple moving average (SMA) is near $193, while the 10-day exponential moving average (EMA) sits around $196–$197. The 20-day SMA and EMA are also clustered near $196–$197, creating an important short-term support area.

Quant (QNT) price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

Further below, the 50-day moving averages are positioned around $177–$180. The 100-day averages range from approximately $120 to $143, while the 200-day averages sit between $95 and $114. The distance between the current price and these longer-term averages reflects the strength of QNT’s preceding advance.

The positioning of the 50-day average above the 200-day average also supports the intermediate bullish structure. However, moving averages are lagging indicators and cannot independently confirm that the recent breakout will continue.

Momentum oscillators offer a more balanced assessment. The Relative Strength Index (RSI) on the daily timeframe is hovering around 49–53, placing it near the midpoint of its range. This suggests that buying pressure has not reached an overbought condition, but neither has momentum established a decisive bullish advantage.

The Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) readings are also mixed. Recent snapshots show the MACD line fluctuating around its signal line, with a negative histogram in some readings. This indicates that the short-term recovery still needs stronger momentum confirmation.

Bollinger Bands provide additional context. The middle band is positioned around $196–$197, while the upper band ranges from approximately $212 to $219. The lower band sits near $175–$179. QNT’s return above the middle band is constructive, although a move toward the upper band would require sustained buying interest.

Key QNT Support and Resistance Levels to Watch

The $200 level remains the central technical reference for QNT. Holding above it could improve market sentiment and provide a foundation for another attempt at nearby resistance.

Immediate support is concentrated between $192 and $197. This zone combines recent trading lows with the short-term moving-average cluster. A sustained move below this area could weaken the recovery and expose lower support levels.

QNT shows bullish momentum after breaking its local downtrend, retesting bull flag support, forming a double bottom near $175, and bouncing off the daily 50-day SMA. Source: @DrewDog12380 via X

The next support region lies between $182 and $189, where the 50-day moving averages and other technical reference levels converge. Below that, the $171–$176 region represents another important demand area, particularly given its relationship with October’s price action.

On the upside, QNT faces initial resistance between $201 and $208. A daily close above this range would strengthen the case for a move toward the $211–$216 area.

The next resistance cluster sits around $223–$226, representing a potential hurdle before the higher targets identified on the 8-hour chart become relevant.

Classic pivot calculations also place immediate resistance near $202, followed by a second resistance level around $212–$213. These levels broadly align with the short-term resistance zones identified through moving averages and recent price action.

A sustained recovery above $216 would improve the technical outlook. It could then open the way toward $238.28, followed by $253.48 and $275.11. The final projected target at $302.67 would require a much stronger continuation of the current upward structure.

Traders Identify $203.85 as an Important Breakout Level

Other market participants are monitoring additional resistance levels that could influence QNT’s next move.

Crypto trader @Ekoanalizz highlighted $203.85 as a key resistance level on the daily chart. The analysis suggests that a decisive breakout could attract additional buying interest and improve the prospects for bullish positions.

The daily QNT chart identifies $203.85 as key resistance, with a breakout potentially triggering a sharp rally and strengthening bullish momentum. Source: @Ekoanalizz via X

The level is particularly relevant because QNT has been consolidating near $200 beneath a descending trendline. The token’s October trading range, which extended roughly between $175 and $223, shows that buyers have yet to establish a sustained move above the broader resistance structure.

Another technical analysis shared by @DrewDog12380 identifies several bullish developments, including a break above a local downtrend, a potential bull flag retest, and a double-bottom formation near $175.

The chart also highlights a rebound from the daily 50-day simple moving average and a bullish RSI crossover. Declining volume during the pullback was identified as another potentially constructive signal, as it could indicate that selling pressure was easing.

That analysis marks upside projections near $312 and $992. However, these are considerably more aggressive than the $302.67 target identified in DigitalChartist’s 8-hour analysis. They should therefore be treated as separate technical scenarios rather than a unified market forecast.

The difference between these projections highlights the uncertainty surrounding QNT’s longer-term price trajectory. A breakout above immediate resistance would provide a clearer basis for evaluating higher targets.

Limited QNT Supply Adds Another Factor to the Market Outlook

Quant’s circulating supply is another factor frequently discussed by traders evaluating its price potential. Estimates cited in market commentary place the circulating supply at approximately 14.5 million QNT, although some traders refer to a figure closer to 12 million when discussing the token’s available float.

A relatively limited circulating supply can influence price movements when demand increases, particularly if available liquidity is thin. However, circulating supply alone does not guarantee a supply squeeze or higher prices. Exchange liquidity, trading volume, token distribution, and broader market conditions also influence price discovery.

At a market capitalization approaching $2.9 billion, QNT already represents a substantial crypto asset. Any sustained advance would therefore require sufficient capital inflows and continued demand rather than relying solely on its limited token supply.

The combination of a falling wedge breakout, a potential bull flag retest, and a recovery above the daily 50-day moving average has attracted bullish attention. Nevertheless, confirmation through price action and trading volume remains essential.

Looking Ahead: Can Quant Reach $302.67?

QNT’s recovery above $200 has improved its near-term technical structure, but the next resistance levels will determine whether the rebound develops into a sustained advance.

The immediate bullish scenario depends on the token maintaining support around $192–$197 and breaking above the $203.85 resistance highlighted by traders. A stronger move through $208 and the $211–$216 resistance cluster would provide additional confirmation.

QNT is retracing toward 100 EMA support, where a rebound could support a resumption of its short-term bullish trend. Source: TradingView

If buying pressure continues and QNT moves above the Ichimoku cloud on the 8-hour chart, the projected targets at $238.28, $253.48, and $275.11 could become relevant. A sustained advance beyond these levels would bring the $302.67 target into focus.

On the other hand, rejection near $203.85 or failure to maintain the $192–$197 support zone could extend the consolidation. A deeper correction may expose the $182–$189 region, followed by support around $171–$176.

For now, the technical picture remains cautiously constructive. QNT’s position above its longer-term moving averages supports the broader uptrend, while neutral daily oscillators indicate that the market has not yet established decisive short-term momentum.

The $200 level, the $203.85 resistance, and the Ichimoku cloud are therefore important areas to monitor as traders assess whether Quant can extend its recovery toward $302.67.

title: Bitcoin Whitepaper Turns 18: How Satoshi’s 9-Page Vision Reshaped Global Finance
summary:
Key Takeaways: On October 31, 2008, the Bitcoin whitepaper was published by Satoshi Nakamoto, which outlines a peer-to-peer electronic cash system, without the need for banks. Eighteen years later, Bitcoin
The post Bitcoin Whitepaper Turns 18: How Satoshi’s 9-Page Vision Reshaped Global Finance appe...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • On October 31, 2008, the Bitcoin whitepaper was published by Satoshi Nakamoto, which outlines a peer-to-peer electronic cash system, without the need for banks.
  • Eighteen years later, Bitcoin developed from a novel monetary system to an asset owned by public organizations, investment funds, and governments.
  • Bitcoin Archive celebrated the occasion on its X page, restating the bold conclusion that the crypto industry began.

Bitcoin’s whitepaper was created on October 31st, 2008, marking 18 years in digital asset history. The initial allotment of nine pages of documents to send the funds without any process of money brokering has now become a worldwide network of trillions of dollars’ worth.

  • Satoshi Nakamoto Introduced a Different Way to Move Money
  • Bitcoin Has Moved Beyond Its Early Cypherpunk Community
    • The 18th Anniversary Brings Attention Back to Satoshi’s Idea

Satoshi Nakamoto Introduced a Different Way to Move Money

On October 31, 2008, an individual or group using the name Satoshi Nakamoto published Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System on a cryptography mailing list.

One major problem with online payments was that too often, financial institutions had to confirm the transfers of funds and avoid double spending. Satoshi envisioned a new peer-to-peer system that did not require central control to function: When people make an exchange, the transaction is verified using cryptographic proof, with a shared and publicly visible record containing the transactions.

This design was a distributed ledger plus proof-of-work. The miners confirm transactions, create new blocks, and miners are rewarded with transactions whenever the network follows the longest chain with largest proof-of-work.

On January 3, 2009, the Bitcoin network came into operation by mining the first block. This protocol later comes to be associated with a maximum supply of 21 million BTC and the assets are issued at a predictable time frame.

Read More: Michael Saylor Teases More Bitcoin After Strategy’s $69.45B Reserve Hits 848,250 BTC

Bitcoin Has Moved Beyond Its Early Cypherpunk Community

The network has since expanded well beyond the realm of cryptography, where the paper first appeared. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs launched in January 2024, providing another channel for traditional investors to buy Bitcoin without owning cryptocurrency wallets.

Public companies are also including Bitcoin on their balance sheets. Some other examples include strategy being the largest publicly listed corporate holder and the U.S. government creating a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve in March 2025 using seized Bitcoins.

This represents a significant shift from Bitcoin’s early years, when every Bitcoin was dominated by technology enthusiasts and early adopters.

The 18th Anniversary Brings Attention Back to Satoshi’s Idea

Bitcoin Archive recently marked the occasion on X with a message celebrating 18 years of Bitcoin and thanking Satoshi Nakamoto. Another aspect of the network’s creation was also touched on in the post, the historic moment.

18 years of Bitcoin.

Thank you, Satoshi — what an incredible journey. https://t.co/DhYNB3SZ9y

— Bitcoin Archive (@BitcoinArchive) October 31, 2026

However, Bitcoin’s original concept has stayed true to its nature, allowing users to make transactions on a public network without a bank or payment company approving it.

Satoshi’s identity remains unknown, and the white paper’s publication began a project that would eventually influence thousands of other digital assets and blockchain networks.

title: Bank of England Opens Tokenized Collateral Door With 2027 Deadline for UK Clearing
summary:
Key Takeaways: The Bank of England is seeking input on tokenized collateral for central clearing. All tokenizable assets must be equally liquid and equally risky in terms of risk. The
The post Bank of England Opens Tokenized Collateral Door With 2027 Deadline for UK Clearing appeared first on Crypto...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • The Bank of England is seeking input on tokenized collateral for central clearing.
  • All tokenizable assets must be equally liquid and equally risky in terms of risk.
  • The consultation will be open until Feb. 12, 2027.

The Bank of England comes closer and closer to introducing tokenized assets into the mainstream of the UK market infrastructure.

The central bank has launched a consultation outlining how central counterparties, or CCPs, could accept tokenized versions of eligible collateral without creating a separate regulatory regime for blockchain-based assets.

  • Bank of England Opens the Door to Tokenized Collateral
  • Same Risk, Same Regulatory Outcome
    • Stablecoins Could Enter the Conversation Later
    • UK Pushes Tokenization Deeper Into Wholesale Finance

Bank of England Opens the Door to Tokenized Collateral

The proposal concentrates on assets that are or could be already collaterized according to the UK’s CCP.

The Bank says tokenization by itself won’t bar an asset from being accepted. What’s important is whether the collateral remains easily transferable and saleable, has little credit risk and market risk, and can still be valued.

The Bank has reported that tokenization of collateral can facilitate trades of assets across markets and jurisdictions, particularly in meeting margin calls. Faster collateral movement could also reduce operational friction in clearing and support wider adoption of digital market infrastructure.

Read More: Blockchain.com and NYSE Target 24/7 Tokenized Stocks for 44 Million Crypto Accounts

Same Risk, Same Regulatory Outcome

The Bank is sticking to a simple rule: tokenized collateral should achieve the same regulatory result as traditional collateral. That means CCPs would need to show that digital representations of assets remain accessible and transferable even during stressed market conditions.

The regulator additionally urges firms to look at the risk associated with technology, custody arrangements and reliance on third-party infrastructure. For instance, tokenized security relying on a bridge that links blockchain records to other asset locations would require knowledge of the consequences of the bridge being compromised.

Stablecoins Could Enter the Conversation Later

The consultation doesn’t instantly add to the list of collaterals that are eligible. It primarily concentrates on the tokenisation of assets currently allowed under the existing regulations, such as cash, financial instruments, bank guarantees and gold, provided they meet established criteria.

But also the Bank´s position is seeking input from industry on a wider array of assets that may qualify in the future. That conversation also covers tokenized money market fund shares, tokenized gold, and stablecoins, so it’s applicable to the entire crypto ecosystem.

Some digital assets could eventually comply with existing collateral standards, the Bank said, and advised firms contemplating digital assets to reach out to supervisors early on.

UK Pushes Tokenization Deeper Into Wholesale Finance

The consultation is part of a wider consultation by the Bank of England, Financial Conduct Authority and HM Treasury in the UK. Their mission is to establish a more straightforward rule for tokenized securities and settlement in the digital medium, while fostering financial stability.

It will help foster responsible tokenization while maintaining the resilience of financial market infrastructure, said Deputy Governor for Financial Stability, Sarah Breeden. The consultation will continue through Feb. 12, 2027, and the Bank takes into account industry comments to decide its supervisory strategy.

title: Jupiter Lend Halts Withdrawals Amid $6.3B Binance Hack Fears Despite Zero Exposure
summary:
Key Takeaways: Following the liquidity crisis due to market turmoil after Binance’s security breach of $6.3 billion, Jupiter Lend has temporarily shut down withdrawals. The protocol claims it never had
The post Jupiter Lend Halts Withdrawals Amid $6.3B Binance Hack Fears Despite Zero Exposure appear...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Following the liquidity crisis due to market turmoil after Binance’s security breach of $6.3 billion, Jupiter Lend has temporarily shut down withdrawals.
  • The protocol claims it never had any exposure to Binance, there have been no funds on the exchange, no loss of funds to report.
  • Withdrawals are likely to begin once loans are repaid and new supplies are available.

Uncertainty about the security issue on Binance has been seeping into the crypto sector and dragging down Jupiter Lend. According to the Solana lending platform, its infrastructure is live, but users will have to wait for the withdrawal of liquidity.

Read More: Binance Says $6.3B Hit in Security Breach, $3B Frozen After DevOps Laptop Compromise

  • Jupiter Lend Faces Liquidity Crunch
  • Why Are Withdrawals Being Delayed?
    • USDC Withdrawable Balance Raises Concerns

Jupiter Lend Faces Liquidity Crunch

On October 30, Jupiter addressed withdrawal delays through its official X account, explaining that broader market conditions had created a liquidity shortage across its lending pools.

Due to broader market conditions, there is currently a liquidity crunch impacting withdrawals.

Market conditions will cause users to deposit or repay their loans. As they do so, withdrawals will be able to process again.

This is normal and expected during events like today’s. Liquidity will soon be available again.

The protocol is functioning as expected and all funds are safe.

— Jupiter Earn (@jupiter_earn) October 30, 2026

Withdrawals would be resumed as market players deposit their assets or repay their loans, the protocol said. It said the situation was normal at all times of significant market volatility and all funds belonging to users are safe.

The announcement came amid increasing security fears surrounding Binance and market actions by the broader crypto sector. Jupiter had earlier said that it was keeping an eye on development and had never had any direct exposure to Binance.

Users asked how there could be any contradiction between the earlier reassurance and the delays in withdrawal, to which Jupiter responded that both the things were correct.

It noted that Binance couldn’t raise any money and the protocol didn’t lose any. The withdrawal pressure is not directly related to the exchange incident, the team said and instead is an indicator of reactions from the wider market.

Read More: Binance $5.5B Hack Exposed: 50 EIP-7702 Nonces Opened One Hot Wallet in Minutes

Why Are Withdrawals Being Delayed?

Jupiter Lend gifts work by means of lending pools where a deposited good can be borrowed by items like Borrow and Multiply. This is because not all deposits will be available immediately as some assets may be used to make loans on the go.

Liquidity may not keep up with the demand for it in periods of heavy withdrawal demand. The repayment of borrowers and fresh money for deposits are therefore significant in restoring withdrawal capacity.

USDC Withdrawable Balance Raises Concerns

Jupiter’s API data aptly pointed to the magnitude of the liquidity situation. Around 418.5 million USDCs in Earn deposit claims, with accrued interest, were visible at 7.14 a.m. ET, whereas 3.35 USDCs were immediately available to withdraw.

This difference reflects the amount of the claims of depositors serviceable by the bank at a given time versus the liquid funds held by the bank. That is not, however, a finding of loan impairment nor a determination that depositors have been losing money on the underlying loans.

In addition to the above, Jupiter documents further withdrawals based on available amounts and permission to withdraw. Users might have to make smaller withdrawals or wait for returns of liquidity.

The withdrawal scenario comes amidst worries over Binance’s security breach, estimated to cause around $6.3 billion damage to Binance.

title: Tether Q3 Profit Hits $1.5B While USDT Reserve Buffer Nearly Doubles to $8B
summary:
Key Takeaways: In Q3, Tether achieved an operating profit of $1.5 billion. Reserve assets rose to almost $8 billion. U.S. Treasury exposure reached $132.4 billion. Tether also added another $1.5
The post Tether Q3 Profit Hits $1.5B While USDT Reserve Buffer Nearly Doubles to $8B appeared first on Cr...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • In Q3, Tether achieved an operating profit of $1.5 billion.
  • Reserve assets rose to almost $8 billion.
  • U.S. Treasury exposure reached $132.4 billion.

Tether also added another $1.5 billion in operating profits during the quarter, and considerably boosted the buffer for USDT. As of the end of September, the stablecoin issuer’s most recent BDO attestation reports $191.5 billion in assets against $183.5 billion in liabilities within total reserves.

Read More: Tether Backs Peso to Expand USDT Payments Across 4 Major Latin American Markets

  • Tether Reserve Buffer Jumps $3.8B in One Quarter
  • Treasury Holdings Drive Tether’s Earnings
    • Nine-Month Operating Profit Reaches $4.5B
    • USDT Still Controls More Than 60% of Stablecoins

Tether Reserve Buffer Jumps $3.8B in One Quarter

Tether’s surpluses surged from $4.1 billion at the end of June to $7.95 billion.

The increase added roughly $3.8 billion to the company’s reserve surplus in a single quarter. Total assets increased to $191.45 billion with total liabilities reaching $183.50 billion, with a majority of the liabilities held by digital tokens issued being about $183.47 billion.

USDT issuance demonstrated overall strength at approximately $184 billion despite fluctuations in market sentiment for cryptocurrencies during the first nine months of 2026.

Treasury Holdings Drive Tether’s Earnings

Tether said U.S. Treasury bills and reverse re-purchase agreements continued to be the primary sources of operating income. As of September 30 government debt represented the primary asset of the reserve portfolio exceeding $132.4 billion via direct and indirect holdings of Treasury bills.

That asset allocation will give them significant short-term liquidity, in short-term, liquid bonds, that can support redeeming when the market is in a state of stress.

Nine-Month Operating Profit Reaches $4.5B

Tether generated $4.5 billion in net operating profit during the first three quarters of 2026.

Q3’s operating profit was reported at $1.5 billion, on par with in Q2. Tether said it had $4.11 billion in reserve for the second quarter, and that number grew dramatically for Q3.

The higher surplus provides Tether with more liquidity to redeem tokens and cover the cost of maintaining infrastructure during tough market conditions, CEO Paolo Ardoino wrote.

The statistics were revealed after Tether underwent its first full independent financial statement audit in August. KPMG U.S. gave an unqualified opinion for the company’s 2025 financial statements.

Read More: Tether Clears First-Ever KPMG Audit, Revealing a $6.8B Cushion for Crypto Markets

USDT Still Controls More Than 60% of Stablecoins

Despite the USDT circulating market capitalization dropping below the $184 billion USDT issuance figure reported in the quarter-end statement, USDT remains the largest dollar-backed token.

DefiLlama revealed that USDT netted a market capitalization of approximately USD 180 billion on 30 October, with the overall market of stablecoins valued at nearly USD 297 billion. This means the USDT is around 60.6% dominant.

The gap indicates the difference between Tether’s September 30 reporting date and the current market data at a point in time circulating.

As excess reserves near $8 billion and the portfolio is heavily weighted with Bitcoin securities, Tether will go into 2026’s 4th quarter with a considerably healthier financial cushion to support the crypto market’s most prominent stable coin.

title: Hoskinson Flags ‘Dangerous’ EIP-7702 Code After Binance’s $6.3B Crypto Breach
summary:
Key Takeaways: Hoskinson issued a warning about “seriously dangerous code” that is associated with the Binance hack. Based on an engineering researcher’s estimate, 50 EIP-7702 authorizations were directed at Binance
The post Hoskinson Flags ‘Dangerous’ EIP-7702 Code After Binance’s $6.3B Crypto Brea...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Hoskinson issued a warning about “seriously dangerous code” that is associated with the Binance hack.
  • Based on an engineering researcher’s estimate, 50 EIP-7702 authorizations were directed at Binance 14.
  • Even for EIP-7702, the account in question must still be properly cryptographically authorized.

Cardano’s founder Charles Hoskinson has echoed worries regarding Ethereum’s EIP-7702, following the investigators’ new allegation that the delegation function could be responsible for part of the massive Binance security breach.

The exchange has lost about $6.3 billion worth of crypto, based on recent reporting, but inquiries into the exact how the attackers obtained signing access continues.

  • Hoskinson Sounds Alarm Over Binance Sweeper Code
  • $823M USDC Vault Was Allegedly Within Reach
    • EIP-7702 Could Speed Execution, but It Cannot Forge Permission
    • Ethereum Specification Already Warns of Delegation Risk

Hoskinson Sounds Alarm Over Binance Sweeper Code

Hoskinson shared a technical breakdown from researcher CyberSatoshi with a blunt warning: “Careful, there is some seriously dangerous code out there.”

Careful, there is some seriously dangerous code out there. https://t.co/w7wM1nn0Lz

— Charles Hoskinson (@IOHK_Charles) October 30, 2026

The Binance wallet known as “Binance 14” was the target of a custom sweeper contract, the analysis states. When guiding the change of the wallet’s own ETH, it allegedly left precisely one ETH behind, which possibly meant that automated transaction systems continued to function as assets were taken away.

The contract also included a design that would continue to execute tokens even if their individual transfers were attempted to be failed.

Read More: Binance $5.5B Hack Exposed: 50 EIP-7702 Nonces Opened One Hot Wallet in Minutes

$823M USDC Vault Was Allegedly Within Reach

CyberSatoshi also stated that the wallet’s compromised execution function enabled it to act on an external vault that held some $823 million in USDC.

Reading the reconstructed bytecode of the Binance EIP-7702 sweeper (`0x63e8…6fae`) is wild.

This wasn’t a generic drainer. It was custom-engineered for Binance 14’s architecture:

– Leaves exactly 1 ether behind (`bal – 1 ether`) when sweeping ETH so Binance’s automated hot wallet queue wouldn’t error on gas and trip alarms.
– Uses raw `staticcall` + `continue` loops with custom error codes (`SweepItemFailed`) so one bricked or blacklisted ERC-20 wouldn’t revert the $6B batch.
– Includes a custom `callExecute` function to impersonate Binance 14 as controller of an external vault holding $823M in USDC.

They leave a comment: “robberies could be prevented if getaway cars were slower.”

You can’t fully blame EIP-7702, but it sped up the attack. Without 7702, draining 64 tokens plus an external $823M vault from a live exchange hot wallet meant fighting moving nonces across 70+ transactions. Defense systems would’ve killed it after tx #3.

With 7702, Lazarus sprayed 50 consecutive nonces in one type-4 payload, turned an EOA into a custom proxy, and atomically swept billions in a single block.

Ethereum core devs built the ultimate getaway car. Surgical state-sponsored engineering.

This could be etched onchain:
`if (bal > 1 ether) { https://t.co/ou2j9VqGvv{value: bal – 1 ether}(“”); }`

— CyberSatoshi 𓆙 (@XBToshi) October 30, 2026

Binance 14 supposedly knew more about that vault and delegated code can act on the basis of that wallet’s already granted just one activity.

They are presented based on researcher’s reconstruction and may not be reliable as Binance has confirmed. However, independent charges have reported seeing an EIP-7702 transaction that has 50 authorizations to be signed by Binance 14.

EIP-7702 Could Speed Execution, but It Cannot Forge Permission

The difference makes a lot of difference. EIP-7702 enables an EO A (Ethernet globally owned account) to delegate execution to the code of a smart contract. An authorization has a chain ID, an address of a delegate and a nonce and a signature. Ethereum checks out the signature prior to delegation.

This will prevent attackers from easily hijacking an arbitrary Binance wallet and loading malicious code on it. Cyber Satoshi’s team also noted that the criminal would have to obtain the private keys or have access to Binance’s signing systems which would be strong enough.

Delegated code, however, when granted access, can be made much more powerful on execution, as the code is executed within the context of the account.

Read More: Binance Says $6.3B Hit in Security Breach, $3B Frozen After DevOps Laptop Compromise

Ethereum Specification Already Warns of Delegation Risk

EIP-7702, officially written documentation of Ethereum, has a strong disclaimer that delegated code is available to full access of the account and should be carefully audited. The specification also relates to the fact that if the contracts of the delegates are not carefully crafted, the malicious party can essentially control the signer’s EOA with very few limitations.

The Binance incident of course gives rise to two distinct security concerns: firstly, how the attackers were able to acquire a valid signing key, and secondly, how it affected the speed and volume of asset transfers after the key was acquired.

Hoskinson’s message stresses the second point and the others are also the crux of uncovering the cause of the breach.
